## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

source                                    results  share of the score

## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Granite 3.0 3B-A800M Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~2.1 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct-GGUF/tree/46f75d55362bc1d5152541ec9579d38381ad7a59))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~3.6 GB) `llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Granite 3.0 3B-A800M Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~2.1 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct-GGUF/tree/46f75d55362bc1d5152541ec9579d38381ad7a59))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~3.6 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct-GGUF@Q8_0 -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Granite 3.0 3B-A800M Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~2.1 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/granite3-moe/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run granite3-moe:3b
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/ibm-granite](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-3.0-3b-a800m-instruct)
